rows.title: High-pressure fuel pipe leak recall on 2009-2011 diesel (3T)
rows.howToFix: Check the VIN against Skoda/DVSA recall records and confirm the recall work (anti-vibration weights on the HP fuel pipes, and the earth/heating-element fix where applicable) has been completed at a dealer free of charge. Any leaking HP pipe must be replaced.

rows.title: Electromechanical parking brake sticking and rapid rear disc/pad wear
rows.howToFix: Have the electronic parking brake actuators/calipers inspected and serviced (the rear calipers can seize). Replace corroded/scored discs and pads as needed and ensure any applicable Skoda recall/TPI on the parking brake has been carried out. Periodic light use of the handbrake on dry roads helps keep rear discs clean.

rows.title: Haldex 4WD Coupling Service Neglect Failure
rows.howToFix: Service Haldex coupling every 30,000 mi: drain fluid, replace filter and o-ring, refill with Haldex-specific oil. €120-€200 at independent. If failed, full coupling replacement €1,500-€2,500.
